outputs.explanation: This is a sequence conservation logo (sequence type), not a plot of averaged data; individual data points are not applicable.
Scatter plot of inhibition zone % with mean ± SEM bars; individual biological replicate values are shown as gray dots overlaid on the mean.
Epifluorescence micrographs of cells; not a summary plot, so individual data points are not applicable.
Scatter plot of fluorescence intensity with mean ± SEM; individual cell values are shown as yellow open circles.
Scatter plot of fluorescence intensity (log scale) with mean ± SEM; individual cell values are shown as blue open circles.
Super-resolution PALM images of single-molecule localizations in representative cells; not a summary plot of aggregated data, so individual points are not applicable in the check's sense.
Scatter plot of number of clusters per cell with mean ± SEM; individual cell values shown as gray open circles.
Scatter plot (log scale) of cluster sizes with mean ± SEM; individual cluster values shown as gray dots.
Scatter plot of percentage of molecules in clusters with mean ± SEM; individual cell values shown as gray open circles.
